semiconductor_relevance: Medium — TET ESTEL specializes in power semiconductor manufacturing technology, which is relevant to power conversion equipment but does not focus on broader semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Tallinna Elektrotehnika Tehas «Estel» AS (TET ESTEL) is a leading manufacturer based in Estonia, specializing in high-quality power semiconductor technology for power conversion equipment. The company offers comprehensive solutions across various industries, managing projects from documentation analysis to commissioning.

regional_presence.Estonia: TET ESTEL is based in Estonia and has a long history of engineering experience in the region.
